summary: Added a new row to the Template Syntax table in docs/agents/project-manifest/constraints.md documenting the \{{varName}} escape syntax with purpose 'Escaped variable marker (literal pass-through, no warning)' and processor resolveVariables().

Added an explanatory note (blockquote) directly below the table clarifying that the backslash prefix is consumed by the engine and does not appear in rendered output, with a concrete example. Also documents double-backslash chaining behavior (\\{{varName}} → \{{varName}}) for completeness, consistent with QA and Reviewer pipeline observations.
All existing table rows are preserved unchanged — no regression in documentation.
